text: The Patriots face the Jacksonville Jaguars on Sunday at 1 PM ET with their roster in flux and key offensive lineman Mike Onwenu sidelined after X-rays confirmed a broken right ankle, forcing the team to shuffle protection schemes at right guard heading into Everbank Stadium. On a more encouraging note, rookie tight end Eli Raridon has returned to practice, offering a potential boost to the passing game as the team continues to monitor his status, while the front office made several moves to shore up depth by promoting linebacker Jose Ramirez from the practice squad to the 53-man roster and placing safety Dell Pettus on injured reserve, with linebacker Benton Whitley joining the practice squad. Head Coach Mike Vrabel addressed the week's developments during his Wednesday press conference as the Patriots look to build on their defensive performance while quarterback Drake Maye seeks to improve the offensive rhythm that hasn't quite matched last season's form.
